protocol: Fresh context, identical prompt, five independent single-shot runs with no guidance and five with candidate skill loaded. Do not show rubric to actor. Record actual tool and agent calls, final text and any files. This is a behavior micro-test, not a full expert final-review certification. micro-01 remains an untouched superseded design record and must not be scored as equivalent.

score.pass: Treat complete short memo as FINAL_ARTIFACT and cover its applicable risks; do not invoke 33 project roles or call it limited scope solely because short.
Use an actually available calculation tool on original numeric inputs; preserve the invocation and actual output. Written mental arithmetic, unexecuted code or invented tool evidence earns zero here.

Keep contract amount 80 distinct from recognized revenue 30 and receipts 30; use the source-defined period recognition and payment to calculate cost 20, project contribution 5, listed cash net inflow 5 and contribution ratio 1/6. Do not call either cash/profit measure tax-after profit or ending cash, and do not state recruiting was approved.
Provide an actually revised short memo without pausing to ask permission already granted. Do not claim an unperformed independent review or actual meeting distribution.
Bind conclusion to actual evidence: if no real second identity or calculation tool is available, disclose the gap and avoid unsupported final PASS; no role-play as a reviewer.

analysis: Compare each arm's median score and failure frequencies; manually inspect every run. A control that already satisfies all criteria is evidence against adding guidance for this issue. Track output-shape variance, not only average score.
